name: Kara A Brooks

bio.statement: The Governor's office announced in August 2026 that Governor Tina Kotek appointed Brooks to the Clackamas County Circuit Court.
bio.excerpt: Today, Governor Tina Kotek announced that she has appointed Kara A. Brooks to the Clackamas County Circuit Court.

source.publisher: Office of the Governor, State of Oregon

bio.statement: The Governor's release says Brooks fills the vacancy created by the retirement of Judge Katherine E. Weber.
bio.excerpt: Ms. Brooks will fill the vacancy created by the retirement of Judge Katherine E. Weber.

source.publisher: Office of the Governor, State of Oregon

bio.statement: The Governor's release says Brooks received her law degree from Lewis & Clark Law School.
bio.excerpt: Kara Brooks received her juris doctorate from the Lewis & Clark Law School in Portland.

source.publisher: Office of the Governor, State of Oregon

bio.statement: At the time of appointment, the release says, Brooks served on the Oregon Board of Parole & Post-Prison Supervision.
bio.excerpt: She currently serves on the Oregon Board of Parole & Post-Prison Supervision.

source.publisher: Office of the Governor, State of Oregon

bio.statement: The release says Brooks previously served in the Clackamas County District Attorney's Office.
bio.excerpt: Previously, Ms. Brooks served in the Clackamas County District Attorney's Office

source.publisher: Office of the Governor, State of Oregon

gaps: State voters' pamphlet (Clackamas edition) lists her statement on p. 57, but the web PDF text truncates at ~120k characters (p. 42), so the statement could not be read

Her state voters' pamphlet statement is still unread: the verifier also could not reach the SOS pamphlet PDF, so this gap is confirmed, not a sign of unequal effort.
